caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic jar with a fitted lid placed slightly to the left of the center on a plain, light beige background. The jar is white with a smooth surface and features a decorative pattern of green leaves and yellow buds that wrap around its body. There are two prominent blue flowers on the jar, one on its main body and another on the lid, rendered in a deep cobalt shade. The lid has a circular handle at the top, also painted with blue detailing. The jar has two thin dark rings near the base and lid for additional accent. The shading indicates a light source from the upper left, casting a shadow to the lower right. A small, handwritten signature is visible below the jar.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
